speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; these are concerning symptoms. To narrow down the cause, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node are highly concerning for a malignancy like lymphoma or a metastatic process. Have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The description of a fixed, painless, newly enlarged neck lump alongside your B symptoms and weight loss is highly suspicious for lymphoma. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential. REQUEST TEST: LDH and ESR levels. REQUEST IMAGES: Neck ultrasound or CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis.
